messages:
Marta R: quick handoff for evening shift — branched incident from 18:12 UTC. embeddings-autoscaler started oscillating in eu-west causing request queuing and 429s for some tenant buckets. pages fired (pager: Alejandro C) and we engaged mitigations. current headline: customer-facing error spikes contained, system on manual scaling. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT opened: INC-20260315-87 | embeddings-autoscaler-high | severity: sev2 | pages: @Alejandro C @Samir P | timeline: 2026-03-15T18:12:34Z | runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.local/embed-autoscaler
Alejandro C: acked. quick timeline notes: saw seq_length histogram jump at ~18:10 then autoscaler hit flapping threshold and started add/remove cycles. attached logs: uploaded host/ew1/autoscaler.log to /shared/ops/6823451000/.
Alejandro C: mitigation steps I ran (in order):
```
# pin autoscaler to stable min/max while we investigate
kubectl -n inference patch hpa embeddings-autoscaler -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 4, "maxReplicas": 8}}'
# cordon noisy nodes and drain workloads
kubectl cordon node-ew1-noisy-3
kubectl drain node-ew1-noisy-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Alejandro C: after that we rolled a fallback routing policy for non-critical tenants to use embed-model-v2-quant (lower throughput but more predictable) — reduced tail latency immediately.
Samir P: added: the autoscaler reconciliation job failed intermittently earlier today (see ops job k8s-job-embed-reconcile-20260315) which left targetPools under-sized. I ran a manual reconcile at 18:20 and it repopulated expected targets. Ops logs show: "reconcile loop error: timeout contacting control-plane" repeated 6x between 17:55-18:05.
OpsBot: k8s-job status snapshot: k8s-job-embed-reconcile-20260315 -> FAILED (exit 1) | lastRestart: 2026-03-15T17:58:04Z | logs: https://ops-logs.internal/jobs/k8s-job-embed-reconcile-20260315.log
Tina L: customer impact note — we saw 2 mid-market tenants with sustained p95 regressions (~2.1s -> 5s) for ~8 minutes, and 1 enterprise tenant experienced brief 503s during the peak scale-down. I've drafted a short vendor-facing blurb, can share after Alejandro confirms the timeline.
Alejandro C: timeline confirmation: spike start ~18:10, autoscaler began flapping 18:12-18:18, manual pin + drain at 18:20, manual reconcile at 18:20, fallback routing applied 18:24, errors back near baseline by 18:30. total customer impact window ~20 minutes.
Marta R: current status: autoscaler in manual (minReplicas=4) pending postmortem. routing fallback still active for low-priority tenants (will keep until autoscaler is proven stable). monitoring: added temp alert for seq_length mean > 1024 for > 5m and for reconcile job failure rate > 3 in 30m.
Samir P: coverage gap to note — APAC on-call was not tagged for this region; primary/secondary model assumes eu-west primary and apac backup but our notify rules didn't escalate to APAC for this autoscaler. recommend adding apac-oncall to autoscaler pager for regional anomalies.
Marta R: action items assigned: Alejandro = lead for immediate postmortem + timeline (due EOD tomorrow), Samir = ops runbook edits and autoscaler reconcile healthcheck (PR by tomorrow), Tina = customer comms draft + coordination with CSMs, me (Marta) = follow up on paging rule fix and schedule capacity tuning session with infra.
Alejandro C: I'll include config diffs + sequence-length histograms in the postmortem. also opening a small test to reproduce noisy-seq pattern against a canary pool.
Tina L: will prepare a short status note for affected tenants with ETA for full postmortem. cc @legal for any sensitivity.
Marta R: handoff: I'm passing primary to @Alejandro C for the night; @Samir P is secondary. If anything else pages related to embeddings-autoscaler, escalate to both. ops channel: link to runbook again: https://runbooks.redwood.local/embed-autoscaler — refer to sections 3 (mitigation) and 7 (postmortem template).
Alejandro C: ack, will update thread if anything changes. I'll also revert manual pins only after a steady 2-hour window with no flapping.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: next scheduled on-call rotation in 6 days. Check rotation schedule: https://schedules.redwood.local/oncall
Marta R: closing note — no active customer outages now, monitoring closely. leaving a checklist for night: 1) monitor seq_length alerts, 2) verify reconcile job stability, 3) confirm fallback routing does not degrade low-priority workload further. please ack this handoff when you pick it up. :white_check_mark:
